title: Mixed Event — Hello to a New Day! — Episode5 All Smiles

meta.Event Outline: It's the start of a new school year and everyone has gone up a grade! That fact hasn't quite hit Ichika yet, but when Miku asks to see the opening ceremony, it spurs her to treat it like a special day.

rows.Line: Kamiyama High School - Class 2-A

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: Hey, wanna go to a karaoke place?

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line:
Yeah, totally!
We should also try inviting that other group!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(What do I do...?
Everyone in this class...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (They basically all seem like... Extroverts...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(How do I fit in here...?
What happens if I never really do...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I did see some familiar names on the roster, but...)
Hey!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Morning, Kusanagi!
So you're also in Class A! Let's have a great year together!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: M-Morning, Shiraishi...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Never would've guessed they'd put me in the same class as you guys.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: M-Morning...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, Akito!
You're in this class too?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah.
Wait, didn't you look at the class roster?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
The roster? Nope.
A friend told me which class I'm in, so I didn't have to look. Plus, coming here was the fastest way to see my new classmates.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: True. You've got nerves of steel when it comes to this kind of stuff...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
What's that supposed to mean?
Just so you know, I still care whether or not my friends are in the same class as me.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I'm glad, though!
It looks like I've talked to basically everyone here at least once before.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Basically everyone? How many friends do you have...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, aren't a bunch of your friends here too? I see all the soccer guys gathered over there.

rows.Speaker: Soccer Club Classmates
rows.Line:
Hey, Akito!
You should come join us!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, in a sec.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (These two... They're so different from me...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, right! Kusanagi!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? Y-Yeah?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Tenma told me everything!
You and your troupe are gonna leave the Wonder Stage to train and become better actors, right?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-Yeah...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Then, that means we're training buddies!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? Training buddies?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm also training to become a better singer. My dad's been taking us to all sorts of different places as a part of that.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
R-Really...?
You guys must be working pretty hard if you're traveling that much.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
We are!
That's why I said we're training buddies, since we're both doing what we can to improve!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Buddies...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Right...
Then, um... Let's do our best.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah!
Pardon the intrusioooooon!!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Uh oh...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Huh...?!
What are they doing where all the second-years are...?!

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: Hey, isn't that the Weirdo Wombo Combo?!

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: What are they doing in our class?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: J-Just pretend like you don't know them...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Heeeey! Neneeee!
How are you liking your new class?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Are you getting along with your new classmates?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: N-No, what are you...?!

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: Nene... Who's that?

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line:
Oh, they mean Kusanagi.
She's over there. She does shows with them.

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: Really? I never would've guessed. She doesn't seem the type.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh geez...!

I knew it!
See, it was Tsukasa's voice we heard just now!
Looks like we weren't mistaken.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: N-Now who's coming...?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: W-Wait, that looks like...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Mizuki. Ah, with Aoyagi in tow.
Can I assume that...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yup! We're both right next door in Class B!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akiyama and I were talking just now and suddenly heard a booming voice from this direction...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We thought it might be Tsukasa, so we decided to see what was going on.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, and here you both are.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Still, Toya, I'm so glad they put us in the same class.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: The teacher asked me to carry a bunch of stuff, but you immediately came to the rescue after I complained how heavy it was♪

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: When faced with a classmate in need, isn't it normal to want to help out?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Indeed!
That was very noble of you, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, Toya, try not to be so easily fooled in the future...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Mizuki does have a talent for that.
I recommend keeping your cards a little closer to your chest.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akiyama's always been very kind to me... I hadn't realized. I'll be more careful.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What?! Rui, don't pile on!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Haha...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Talk about a rough road up ahead...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, I think they're gonna get along just fine!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Agreed!
If nothing else, I'm happy to see that everyone is all smiles!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Everyone, let's make this year another good one!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, let's.
